hero.badge: Built for the UAE e-invoicing mandate
hero.title: Your firm's clients, mandate-ready before the deadline
hero.subtitle: An in-house agent orchestra reads, extracts and verifies invoices automatically, so your team reviews decisions instead of retyping documents.

orchestra.title: An agent orchestra, not a single bot
orchestra.subtitle: Every document moves through a traceable pipeline. Each step is logged, budgeted and reviewable.
orchestra.intake: Intake — reads the upload and classifies the document
orchestra.extraction: Extraction — pulls invoice fields with confidence scores
orchestra.verifier: Verifier — runs checks and escalates what looks wrong
orchestra.orchestrator: Orchestrator — plans the run and keeps every step accountable

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: Drop a PDF, image, CSV or XLSX. We dedupe by content hash automatically.

steps.title: Extract
steps.body: Intake and Extraction agents turn the document into structured invoice data.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: The Verifier runs checks and flags anything that needs a human look.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Your team approves or adjusts proposals; nothing ships to a client unreviewed.

trust.title: Built with compliance in mind
points: Every Firm's data is isolated at the database level
Agents never write business state directly
A full audit trail for every decision
No invoice is sent to a client without human review

cta.title: Get your clients ready
cta.body: Open a workspace for your firm and start validating invoices ahead of the mandate.

missingFields.title: Missing required fields

review.title: Invoice review
review.notFound: This invoice was not found. It may belong to another firm.
review.pending: The invoice is being processed. This page updates by itself.
review.timeout: Processing is taking longer than expected. Refresh to check again.

next.has_issues: Fix every error below, then re-validate. Warnings do not block approval.
next.validated: No errors. Approve the invoice to make it ready for export.
next.ready: Approved and ready. Export the PINT-AE XML.
next.needs_review: This invoice needs a human look before it can be validated.
next.fixed: Your change is saved. Re-validation is running.

issues.title: Issues
issues.none: No issues. The validator found nothing to fix.
issues.noField: This issue is about the whole document, so there is no single field to edit.

audit.title: Audit trail

errors.stale_payload: Someone changed this invoice while you were editing. It was reloaded, so check it and try again.
errors.old_value_mismatch: The field no longer holds the value you saw. It was reloaded, so try again.
errors.bad_path: That field cannot be edited here.
errors.not_validated: Only a validated invoice can be approved. Re-validate it first.
errors.not_ready: Only an approved invoice can be exported. Approve it first.
errors.revalidation_required: The invoice changed since it was approved. Re-validate and approve it again.
errors.validator_unavailable: The validator is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.exporter_unavailable: The exporter is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may belong to another firm.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.upstream_unavailable: The backend is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
